We meet to read one or more papers closely. Each meeting is summarised here: what
the paper claimed, what we discussed, what stayed unresolved, and what we might
read next. New members and visitors are welcome.

::: {.next-meeting}
### Next meeting · November 2026

**Date and time:** To be announced

**Discussion lead:** Guan

We will read Jiang, Wang & Li, [*Beyond differential expression: Differential
variability as an underappreciated axis in transcriptomics*](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cels.2026.101706)
(*Cell Systems*, 2026).

This commentary reanalyses data from [Sun et al.'s 2024 memory study](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-023-07011-6),
following a [statistical critique](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-025-08988-y)
and [reply](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41586-025-08989-x).
The authors question the original differential expression results. Their
reanalysis reports memory-related signals in *differential variability*:
changes in how widely gene expression varies between cells, rather than changes
in the mean alone. We will discuss what that evidence supports and how to test it.

This is likely our final journal club meeting of 2026. We will announce the time
once it is confirmed.
:::
